{{Top|leg}}
The '''Je'har''' were the upper caste of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Almania]], based in the [[Great Dome of the Je'har]]. They originally were supporters of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], but underwent a shift to a dictatorial, tyrannical ruling class during the [[Thrawn campaign]].

During a raid against the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Pydyr]], the Je'har [[Death/Legends|killed]] the parents of a young [[Gender/Legends|man]] named Dolph. After seeing his parents' corpses, Dolph turned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and became [[Kueller]]. He then returned to Almania and slaughtered the Je'har regime.
